## Group 22: What's Trending in Gaming on Bluesky?

```{r Config, include = FALSE}
library(dotenv)
library(atrrr)
library(dplyr)
library(tm)

dotenv::load_dot_env("../.env")

bsky_handle <- Sys.getenv("BLUESKY_HANDLE")
bsky_password <- Sys.getenv("BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD")

auth(user = bsky_handle, password = bsky_password)
load("../data/raw/searchGamingData.RData")
```


```{r creatingCorpus, echo=FALSE, child="data_collection.rmd"}
# Convert all post text to a corpus.
corpus = Corpus(VectorSource(all_skeets_texts))

# Convert text to ASCII.
corpus = tm_map(corpus, function(x) iconv(x, to = "ASCII"))

```

```{r removeWords}
# Optionally remove names and standard stops words
corpus = tm_map(
  corpus,
  removeWords,
  c(
    stopwords(),
    "Sony", "Ubisoft",
    "Nintendo", "Valve",
    "Xbox", "Microsoft"
  )
)
```


# Clean the text while creating the term-document matrix.

``` {r}
# Remove URLs before punctuation removal.
remove_urls = content_transformer(function(x) {
  gsub("https?://\\S+|www\\.\\S+", " ", x, perl = TRUE)
})
corpus = tm_map(corpus, remove_urls)


#Cleaning and Building the Matrix
tdm = TermDocumentMatrix(
  corpus,
  control = list(
  removePunctuation = TRUE,
  stopwords = TRUE,
  removeNumbers = TRUE,
  tolower = TRUE,
  stemming = TRUE
  )
)

# Remove documents left empty by cleaning.
empties = which(colSums(as.matrix(tdm)) == 0)
tdm = tdm[, -empties]

# Convert to a standard matrix.
M = as.matrix(tdm)
dim(M)
```
